source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 12 to 16
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor October 9, 2026 · 14 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Castlevania: Belmont's Curse KONAMI ☆☆☆☆☆ 116 ★★★★★ Get it now Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse – October 15 XBOX Play Anywhere 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows. Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle. Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation? Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 Activision Publishing Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $69.99 Pre-order Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (Campaign Early Access) XBOX Play Anywhere Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point. Pre-order Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 today to gain Early Access to the game’s Campaign starting Friday, October 16 ahead of its global launch on October 23. Deep Dish Dungeon Raw Fury AB ☆☆☆☆☆ 234 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Deep Dish Dungeon – October 13Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Deep Dish Dungeon is a dungeon crawler and exploration game that rewards curiosity and resourcefulness. In an atmospheric environment, explore corridors, rooms and passageways solo or with up to two friends, and gather resources to improve your camping site. Craft tools and cook nourishing meals to bolster strength throughout the journey, and unravel the enigma that lies within the shadows. Planet Zoo 2 Frontier Developments ☆☆☆☆☆ 53 ★★★★★ Get it now Planet Zoo 2 – October 13XBOX Play Anywhere Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2 – the sequel to the beloved zoo simulation game. Let your creativity soar by constructing and managing distinctive zoos around the world, full of awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species for the first time. Plus, take the next step in animal conservation and release your species into customisable, expansive Wildlife Reserves. Valor Mortis Lyrical Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 744 ★★★★★ $39.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Valor Mortis – October 13Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere You served Napoleon. You died for Napoleon. You have risen for Napoleon. You are William, a soldier of the Grande Armée brought back from a battlefield grave. But the Europe you awaken to is not the one you sacrificed for. A mysterious plague now sweeps the continent, and you have been reborn with its corrupting power pulsing through your veins. Each death is a chance to grow stronger. Master a combat system of parries, dashes, and visceral finishers across a variety of weapons. Channel your power to enhance attacks and unlock new supernatural abilities to inflict upon your enemies. Just Dance: Decades of Hits Ubisoft ☆☆☆☆☆ 169 ★★★★★ $39.99 Get it now Just Dance: Decades of Hits – October 13 Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography. Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades. Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea Natsume Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 3 ★★★★★ Get it now Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea – October 14 Embark on an unforgettable journey through the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure! Raised in the quiet comfort of Bloomfield Village, your life is about to change forever. A mysterious mist creeps from the Forest of Echoes, wild beasts roam under the cover of night, and strange disasters threaten villages across the land. Venture across a vast, living landscape filled with hidden caves, remote islands, lively towns, and long-forgotten secrets. Between your travels, cultivate your farm, raise animals, harvest crops, and build a place to call home. Guided by the Harvest Goddess and aided by the friends you’ll meet along the way, you’ll find new ways to grow, explore, and lend a hand wherever it’s needed. Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 Devolver Digital, Big Fan Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 40 ★★★★★ $24.99 Get it now Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 – October 14 Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is the brutal and fast-paced sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun. Following directly on from the end of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, your duty takes you to new locations in a branching, single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grimdark Warhammer 40,000 universe with a fast-paced first-person shooter. Bluey's Happy Snaps Gameloft ☆☆☆☆☆ 45 ★★★★★ $39.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Bluey’s Happy Snaps – October 15Game Pass / Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Play, explore, and capture moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered adventure across familiar spots from the show. Snap memories solo or side-by-side with a second player, discover Australian wildlife, and turn in-game moments into real fun for Real Life. Bluey and Bingo have found Dad’s old camera (back from when he was cool). Take it with you around Bluey’s hometown of Brisbane as you snap photos of the games you play, chase bin chickens and uncover hidden surprises. Each snapshot is saved to your own scrapbook, where you can keep your best moments. source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 5 to 9
source.evidenceText: Mike Nelson, XBOX Wire Editor October 2, 2026 · 7 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Gears of War: E-Day Pre-Order Xbox Game Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ 4664 ★★★★★ Get it now Gears of War: E-Day – October 6Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Experience the horror and brutality of Emergence Day. Fourteen years before the original Gears of War, join Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago in a gripping origin-story campaign as the Locust Horde first erupt from below, igniting a desperate fight for survival. Rally your squad and fight on in multiplayer with a reimagination of Gears’ iconic PvE mode, Horde Siege, or go head-to-head with a refined Versus PvP. Built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers the most immersive Gears yet. STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ Secret Mode ☆☆☆☆☆ 311 ★★★★★ Get it now STAR WARS: Galactic Racer – October 6 A ​​runs-based​​, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim of the ​​STAR WARS​​ galaxy.​​​​ The Empire’s grip on the galaxy has finally broken, and with its fall comes a new obsession: speed. As the New Republic struggles to rebuild, gambling, entertainment, and glory fuel a booming underground. Out of this chaos, the Galactic League is born: an unsanctioned racing circuit where syndicates sponsor pilots, fortunes are won and lost in seconds, and only the bold survive. No Force. No prophecy. Just skill, strategy, and the will to rise. KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III] SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. ☆☆☆☆☆ 66 ★★★★★ $74.99 Get it now KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III] – October 6XBOX Play Anywhere A value‑packed bundle featuring three collections: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-, KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC). Echo Weaver Akupara Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 146 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Free Trial Echo Weaver – October 8Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop. Hidden Dogs Silesia Games Sp. z o.o. ☆☆☆☆☆ 17 ★★★★★ $4.99 $3.99 Get it now Hidden Dogs – October 7 Welcome to puppy village! Labby needs your help with a top-secret mission: creating a video game just for dogs (move over, cats!). Find 500+ hidden dogs and items scattered across 15 cozy, hand-drawn levels in the English countryside. Got stuck? Just blow the dog whistle! Keep finding pups to watch the map grow and come to life with moving planes, boats, and trains! Titanic Escape Simulator MagicProStudio ☆☆☆☆☆ 24 ★★★★★ $24.99 Get it now Titanic Escape Simulator – October 7XBOX Play Anywhere You are a private investigator aboard the world’s most famous ocean liner. What begins as a routine voyage soon becomes something far darker: a suspicious death, hidden clues, locked rooms, restricted decks, and a mystery buried deep within the ship. Explore the Titanic before disaster strikes. Question passengers, search cabins, uncover secrets, and follow a trail that leads from the elegance of First Class to the shadowed lower decks below. But as the truth begins to surface, so does the danger. Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire JanduSoft ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire – October 7XBOX Play Anywhere An action-farming-roguelite set in Transylvania, the homeland of Dracula and his rebellious lastborn son, Voltaire. An epiphany results in a change of heart for the young vampire: abandoning blood in favor of a plant-based diet out of spite to prove to his father that neck-biting is not the only way for vampires to thrive. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival Saber Interactive Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 425 ★★★★★ Get it now Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival – October 8 Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Play the story of Aidan, who must use the power of a mysterious puzzle box – the Genesis Configuration – to help his girlfriend Sunny’s escape from the otherworldly hellscape of the Labyrinth. Wield the powers of the box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead and do battle with the horrific cult devoted to the Cenobites. Neon Abyss 2 Kepler Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ 309 ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Neon Abyss 2 – October 8XBOX Play Anywhere Dive deeper into the chaotic, beautifully pixelated Abyss with Neon Abyss 2! The action is faster, the stakes are higher, and the possibilities are endless in this cybermyth roguelike. With explosive run ‘n’ gun gameplay, diverse combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, Neon Abyss 2 delivers a dramatic, thrill-packed experience every time you enter. Deck of Haunts DANGEN Entertainment ☆☆☆☆☆ 28 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now Deck of Haunts – October 8 Deck of Haunts invites you to step into the eerie role of a malevolent Haunted House, where the walls whisper secrets and terror lurks around every corner. As the master of this cursed domain, your goal is to ensnare daring humans, play on their fears, and drain their very essence to expand your dark influence. Forever Ago Annapurna Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ 448 ★★★★★ $19.99 $17.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Forever Ago – October 8XBOX Play Anywhere Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you’ll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting characters, and even make some new friends.
